name: Tea Tree
source_reference: ISO 4730:2017 - Oil of Melaleuca, terpinen-4-ol type; Carson et al., Clinical Microbiology Reviews, 2006
notes: Quality is defined by ISO 4730: terpinen-4-ol must be >30% and 1,8-cineole must be <15%. High-cineole chemotypes are considered inferior for therapeutic and fragrance use.

key_markers.562-74-3: Terpinen-4-ol - primary active and olfactive component, must exceed 30% per ISO 4730
key_markers.99-85-4: gamma-Terpinene - key monoterpene precursor of terpinen-4-ol during storage
key_markers.489-39-4: Aromadendrene - sesquiterpene marker characteristic of Melaleuca species

olfactive_description: Fresh, medicinal-camphoraceous with distinctive warm-spicy terpenic character. Clean, slightly peppery with green-herbaceous nuances. More spicy than eucalyptus.
